# Contributing to PiCompose-Package-Hello

Everybody is invited and welcome to contribute to PiCompose-Package-Hello. Packaging fixes are appreciated.

- Fork the repository.
- Create a branch and make your change.
- Write a clear title and description for the Pull Request. They become the changelog entry of the package, the version is counted up by the build.
- Create a Pull Request against the `main` branch and tick exactly one box under "Types of changes". CI derives the label from it, and the label decides where the PR appears in the release notes.

## Issue Tracker

If you want to report a problem with this package, please create an issue and use the template. Problems with the APT repository belong in the [PiCompose-Repository](https://github.com/florian-asche/PiCompose-Repository/issues) repository.

## AI Policy

AI tools are allowed, but a human is responsible and must review and understand every change. Autonomous agents and unreviewed AI output will be rejected. See [AI_POLICY.md](AI_POLICY.md).
